description:
IMATEC is an Erasmus Mundus master in advanced materials and technologies, combining materials design, processing and characterisation across a European consortium. Its admissions page carries the current call, eligibility list and scholarship arrangements for the next cohort.

Programme Highlights

  • Materials-to-manufacturing pipeline with industrial partners
  • Characterisation-lab training across consortium campuses
  • Admissions round announced annually on the official page
  • Careers in materials R&D, manufacturing innovation and doctoral study

Who Should Apply

Materials science, mechanical and chemical engineering graduates fit the entry profile, with laboratory experience valued.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the IMATEC admissions page and submit the application form with the listed documents during the live round. Key deadline information: Admissions round and closing date published on the official admissions page.
